_readme: The demo's one non-NPC interaction. It exists so the shipped game exercises the
object path on every CI run - an interaction verb that only appears in a second
game is a verb the demo's own gates never touch.

read.speaker: The well
read.text: A notice, nailed to the frame: DO NOT DRINK. (Someone has crossed out DRINK and written FALL IN.)

look.speaker: The well
look.text: You lean over. Water, and a very small version of your own face.
